title: Feeling place names
description: About 3,400 US lakes, creeks, peaks and towns are named for an emotion, from Mount Pleasant to Lake Desolation. The West has 22% of the good-feeling names but 47% of the bad ones: settlers back east chose Pleasant and Hope, while the prospectors and surveyors out West named things Lonesome, Misery and Disappointment. Names from the USGS Geographic Names Information System.
